game.name: Baizhu
game.title: Beyond Mortality
game.description: The owner of Bubu Pharmacy, who is rarely seen without the white snake named Changsheng. His medicinal knowledge is encyclopedic, and his personal intrigues subtle.

game.name: Beidou
game.title: Uncrowned Lord of the Ocean
game.description: Captain of her crew, The Crux. She's quite an unbound and forthright woman.

game.name: Chongyun
game.title: Frozen Ardor
game.description: A young exorcist from a family of exorcists. He does everything he can to suppress his abundance of yang energy.

game.name: Gaming
game.title: Leonine Vanguard
game.affiliation: Sword and Strongbox Secure Transport Agency
game.description: Guard of the Sword and Strongbox Secure Transport Agency, and the head of the "Mighty Mythical Beasts" Wushou troupe.

game.name: Ganyu
game.title: Plenilune Gaze
game.description: The secretary at Yuehai Pavilion. The blood of the qilin, an illuminated beast, flows within her veins.

game.name: Hu Tao
game.title: Fragrance in Thaw
game.description: The 77th Director of the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. She took over the business at a rather young age.

game.name: Keqing
game.title: Driving Thunder
game.description: The Yuheng of the Liyue Qixing. Has much to say about Rex Lapis' unilateral approach to policymaking in Liyue - but in truth, gods admire skeptics such as her quite a lot.

game.name: Ningguang
game.title: Eclipsing Star
game.description: The Tianquan of Liyue Qixing. Her wealth is unsurpassed in all of Teyvat.

game.name: Qiqi
game.title: Icy Resurrection
game.description: An apprentice and herb gatherer at Bubu Pharmacy. An undead with a bone-white complexion, she seldom has much in the way of words or emotion.

game.name: Shenhe
game.title: Lonesome Transcendence
game.description: An adepti disciple with a most unusual air about her. Having spent much time cultivating in isolation in Liyue's mountains, she has become every bit as cool and distant as the adepti themselves.

game.name: Xiangling
game.title: Exquisite Delicacy
game.description: A renowned chef from Liyue. She's extremely passionate about cooking and excels at making her signature hot and spicy dishes.

game.name: Xianyun
game.title: Passerine Herald
game.description: One of the Mighty and Illuminated Adepti of Jueyun, known as "Cloud Retainer." Expert in all kinds of mechanical contraptions, her heart now turns towards the affairs of the mortal world, through which she walks under the name "Xianyun."

game.name: Xiao
game.title: Vigilant Yaksha
game.description: A yaksha adeptus that defends Liyue. Also heralded as the "Conqueror of Demons" and "Vigilant Yaksha."

game.name: Xingqiu
game.title: Juvenile Galant
game.description: A young man carrying a longsword who is frequently seen at book booths. He has a chivalrous heart and yearns for justice and fairness for all.

game.name: Xinyan
game.title: Blazing Riff
game.description: Liyue's sole rock 'n' roll musician. She rebels against ossified prejudices using her music and passionate singing.

game.name: Yanfei
game.title: Wise Innocence
game.description: A well-known legal adviser active in Liyue Harbor. A brilliant young lady in whose veins runs the blood of an illuminated beast.

game.name: Yaoyao
game.title: Burgeoning Grace
game.description: Streetward Rambler's youngest disciple. A gentle and caring “little adult.”

game.name: Yelan
game.title: Valley Orchid
game.description: A mysterious person who claims to work for the Ministry of Civil Affairs, but is a "non-entity" on the Ministry of Civil Affairs' list.

game.name: Yun Jin
game.title: Stage Lucida
game.description: A renowned Liyue opera singer who is skilled in both playwriting and singing. Her style is one-of-a-kind, exquisite and delicate, much like the person herself.

game.name: Zhongli
game.title: Vago Mundo
game.description: A mysterious expert contracted by the Wangsheng Funeral Parlor. Extremely knowledgeable in all things.
